newsitem.title: USA: Westmoreland may seek other listing.
newsitem.headline: Westmoreland may seek other listing.

text.p: Westmoreland Coal Co on Wednesday said it would consider alternative securities markets, having received notice of the New York Stock Exchange's intention to suspend trading and delist its stock.

The company filed for bankruptcy protection in December after failing to settle a dispute with the United Mine Workers of America Pension and Benefit Funds over retiree benefit obligations for people who had worked in the coal industry but not for Westmoreland.
The company, which has headquarters in Colorado Springs, Colorado, said it would be able to seek listing of its securities once the bankruptcy court approved its plan of reorganization.
Westmoreland said it was below NYSE listing standings at the time of its last quarterly filing on September 30.

NYSE had told the company, among other things, that Westmoreland could not adequately assure that it would be successful in submitting and obtaining confirmation of its reorganization plan, bringing it in line with original listing standards, it said.
